ingredientIntelligence.notes: Only direct, restaurant-issued menu ingredient positives are recorded. Empty arrays mean unavailable, not allergen-free.

summary: Firefly is verified at 1310 New Hampshire Avenue NW. The official current page exposes ten complete food/nonalcoholic menu families, projected here as 87 unique products. Fifteen frozen description fragments map to current products and two are stale. No formal allergen matrix was found; direct official ingredient text supports only partial positive claims, and all undeclared allergens remain unavailable.
